sb_alien_number.label: Alien Registration Number (A-Number) — if applicable
sb_alien_number.hint: Format: A followed by 8 or 9 digits. Example: A012345678

sb_uscis_online.label: USCIS Online Account Number — if applicable

sb_end_rua.label: Current Address — Street Number and Name

sb_end_tipo_unidade.label: Current Address — Unit Type (if applicable)
sb_end_tipo_unidade.hint: Apt = apartment, Ste = suite, Flr = floor. Leave blank if this doesn't apply to your address.

sb_end_ate.label: Until when (MM/DD/YYYY, or 'PRESENT' if you still live there)

sb_end_ant1_rua.label: Previous Address — Street Number and Name (last 5 years, if you had another address)
sb_end_ant1_rua.hint: Only fill this in if you've lived at your current address for less than 5 years (counting from today). If you've lived there 5 years or more, leave it blank.

sb_end_ant1_tipo_unidade.label: Previous Address — Unit Type (if applicable)
sb_end_ant1_tipo_unidade.hint: Apt = apartment, Ste = suite, Flr = floor. Leave blank if this doesn't apply.

sb_end_ant1_provincia.label: Previous Address — Province (if outside the U.S.)

sb_end_ant1_codigo_postal.label: Previous Address — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

sb_end_ext_rua.label: Last Address Outside the U.S. (more than 1 year, even if already listed above) — Street Number and Name
sb_end_ext_rua.hint: A separate, required USCIS question: your last foreign address where you lived for more than 1 year — even if already listed above, or if it was many years ago. Used for background-check purposes.

sb_end_ext_tipo_unidade.label: Address Outside the U.S. — Unit Type (if applicable)
sb_end_ext_tipo_unidade.hint: Apt = apartment, Ste = suite, Flr = floor. Leave blank if this doesn't apply.

sb_end_ext_num_unidade.label: Address Outside the U.S. — Unit Number

sb_end_ext_cidade.label: Address Outside the U.S. — City or Town

sb_end_ext_codigo_postal.label: Address Outside the U.S. — Postal Code

pai1_sobrenome.label: Parent 1 — Family Name (maiden name, if applicable)
pai1_sobrenome.hint: Your parent's birth surname (before any marriage), not their current surname if different. If a parent is deceased or you don't have this information, fill in what you know and let the team know.

pai2_sobrenome.label: Parent 2 — Family Name (maiden name, if applicable)
pai2_sobrenome.hint: Your parent's birth surname (before any marriage), not their current surname if different. If a parent is deceased or you don't have this information, fill in what you know and let the team know.

emp1_nome.label: Current Employer — Employer/Company Name
emp1_nome.hint: If you are currently unemployed, enter 'Unemployed'.

emp1_end_rua.label: Current Employer — Street Number and Name

emp1_end_tipo_unidade.label: Current Employer — Unit Type (if applicable)
emp1_end_tipo_unidade.hint: Apt = apartment, Ste = suite, Flr = floor. Leave blank if this doesn't apply.

emp1_end_provincia.label: Current Employer — Province (if outside the U.S.)

emp1_end_codigo_postal.label: Current Employer — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

emp2_end_tipo_unidade.hint: Apt = apartment, Ste = suite, Flr = floor. Leave blank if this doesn't apply.

emp2_end_provincia.label: Previous Employer — Province (if outside the U.S.)

emp2_end_codigo_postal.label: Previous Employer — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

ass_leu_ingles.label: Spouse beneficiary's statement

options.leu_ingles: I can read and understand English, and I have read and understood every question and instruction on this form, as well as my answers
options.leu_interprete: The interpreter named in Part 5 read every question and instruction on this form and my answers to me in a language I understand fluently

ass_leu_ingles.hint: Only choose the second option if you don't read or understand English well and needed an interpreter to translate the form for you before signing.

ass_idioma.label: In what language did the interpreter read the form to you?

ass_preparador_ajudou.label: Did someone prepare this form for you, at your request and based only on the information you provided?
ass_preparador_ajudou.hint: Answer "Yes" only if someone else (attorney, consultant, friend) filled out this form for you based on your answers. If you typed/filled it out yourself, answer "No, I filled it out myself," even if you got guidance from someone else.

ass_data_assinatura.label: Date of Signature (filled in on the day of filing, MM/DD/YYYY)
